string.text: Improved recoil pad
Softer recoil pad with better shock-absorption improves handling.
Sawed-off stock
Without a stock the rifle is noticeably maintenance, increasing mobility, at the expense of higher recoil.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Sawed-off barrel
Significantly shortened barrel cuts weight, increases mobility and pellet spread, reduces effective range and accuracy.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improves accuracy while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Barrel lapping
Increases muzzle velocity and reduces weapon wear.
Lightweight handguard
maintenance handguard decreases overall weight of the weapon.
Titanium hinge
More durable hinge pin improves wear-resistance of the break-action mechanism.
Improved hammers
Reduces the probability of misfires related to insufficient indent.
Complex adjustment
Complex modification concerning almost every action of the firearm. Improves accuracy and recoil.
Rifled barrel
Barrel rifling increases muzzle velocity and accuracy, however makes the use of buckshot impossible.
Protective coating
Application of a protective coating to the barrels significantly reduces wear, increasing rifle's lifespan.
